info.description: REST API documentation for Fleet Management System
info.title: Fleet Management System API

get.description: Returns the total number of trips completed today
Returns the number of vehicles currently in transit

post.description: Initiates password reset by sending a reset token to the user email
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token
Creates a new user by delegating to the identity service

put.description: Resets a user password using a valid password reset token

post.description: Verifies a user's email address using a 6-digit verification token

get.description: Get all drivers belonging to an organization

post.description: Create a new driver in the fleet service

put.description: Update driver first or last name

get.description: Get trips across all organizations of authenticated user

post.description: Marks trip as completed and sets end_time
Marks trip as started and sets start_time

get.description: Returns vehicles belonging to an organization

post.description: Creates a vehicle in the fleet service

get.description: Returns vehicles belonging to all organizations of the user
Get vehicle details by vehicle ID

put.description: Update vehicle plate, type, or capacity

get.description: Checks API health and connectivity with identity service
Returns organizations the authenticated user belongs to

post.description: Creates a new organization owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Get details of a specific organization by ID

post.description: Adds an existing user to an organization with a role

get.description: Returns members of an organization enriched with user profile data

delete.description: Removes a user from an organization

put.description: Updates the role of a member within an organization
